text:
Priya: quick sync - thinking about adding an autosnapshot + pause heuristic for feature flag rollouts. want a short thread on constraints.
Diego: good idea. autosnapshots = take a config snapshot on change + allow quick rollback, right?
Priya: yup. plus heuristic that pauses rollout when combined quota delta + latency delta exceed safe bounds.
Sam: propose rule: if estimated token burn delta > 30% AND p95 latency increases > 20% for 2 windows => create autosnapshot + mark rollout paused.
Nate: we should avoid pausing on infra cold starts. how do we detect warmup noise?
Priya: add warmup exclusion: ignore signals for first 8 minutes after commit unless cohort > 10%.
Diego: where does this live? proxy-level detectors or central service?
Sam: central service again. subscribes to metrics stream and config-change feed. writes events to rollout_audit table.
Priya: also want a small "snapshot" button in console so engineers can snapshot+rollback without filing a ticket. UI-bot can mock?
UI-bot: mock uploaded to Figma: https://figma.internal/rollouts/autosnap-card :sparkles:
Nate: pause semantics? immediate stop vs graceful drain? I'd vote graceful drain as default.
Sam: same. API we sketched: `POST /api/rollouts/{id}/action` body `{"action":"pause","mode":"drain"}`. returns 202 + job id.
Priya: need operator TTL override too. default TTL 20m. allow `force_unpause` with audit.
Diego: telemetry: tag snapshots with `snapshot.reason` and include `est_token_delta`, `p95_delta_ms`, `cohort_pct`.
Nate: do we alert product owners? maybe quiet channel first then escalate.
Priya: alert levels: `note` -> #eng-platform, `warn` -> #eng-oncall, `alert` -> pager. default `note` for first-4-hours after rollout creation.
Sam: can we add a simulated estimator to console that shows projected token delta for a given cohort? helps PMs decide canary sizes.
UI-bot: will add a tiny estimator card mock (inputs: baseline qps, cohort %, expected per-request tokens).
Diego: storage: rollout_audit schema needs fields: rollout_id, commit, snapshot_id, trigger_type, trigger_value, action, actor, created_at.
Priya: +1. also store probe run_id so we can replay signal evaluation.
Nate: test plan: (1) shadow mode writing events for 72h, (2) enable autosnapshot but not auto-pause for another 24h, (3) enable full flow in staging and run synthetic spike job.
Sam: sample synthetic spike job: `python tools/sim/spike.py --target rollout:1234 --rps 500 --duration 600`
Diego: ops-bot: can you create a runbook draft and a slack alias for snapshots?
ops-bot: created runbook: rollout_autosnap_v1. slack alias `#rollout-autosnap` created. Docs: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rollout_autosnap_v1 :white_check_mark:
Priya: owners: Priya -> product rules + gating, Sam -> pause API, Diego -> estimator + telemetry, Nate -> runbook + staging tests.
Priya: timeline: shadow events by Fri EOD, autosnapshot UI (mock) by next Tue, autopause toggles after successful staging test.
Sam: tiny nit - ensure rollback button includes diff view and a "preview traffic change" modal before apply.
Priya: agreed. ok leaving thread. ping if blockers. :rocket:
